title: Judas' anger and death
description: When Judas, who had betrayed Jesus, saw that he was condemned, he regretted his actions and brought the thirty silver coins back to the chief priests and the elders. He said, "I have sinned by betraying innocent blood", but they replied, "What is that to us? See to it yourself." Judas threw the money into the temple and went away and hanged himself. The chief priests decided the money could not be put into the temple treasury since it was payment for blood, so they used it to buy the potter's field as a burial place for foreigners. That is why the place has been called the Field of Blood to this day. In this way the prophecy spoken through Jeremiah about the thirty silver coins and the potter's field was fulfilled.
